name: mediawiki-beta
description: Docker container for MediaWiki running on Alpine, S6-overlay, Nginx, PHP-FPM, MediaWiki Parsoid service, WYSIWYG VisualEditor extension, along with other extensions. A CLI menu to simplify managing extensions, backups, database updates, and service configurations, scripts that handle setup and Mediawiki upgrades, and *optional* MariaDB add-in.

paths.name: File Uploads Dir
paths.description: OPTIONAL: Set a host path for file uploads. <br> Container Path: /config/assets

paths.name: Backup Dir
paths.description: OPTIONAL: Set a host path for backups. <br> Container Path: /config/backup

variables.name: Allow Mediawiki Upgrades
variables.description: Allow MediaWiki to automatically be upgraded with new docker images./br Set 'enable' to allow upgrades.

variables.name: Install MySQL/MariaDB
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Set 'true' to install built in MySQL/MariaDB

variables.name: MySQL Root Password
variables.description: Default: ROOT_ACCESS_PASSWORD<br> Once the database has been initialized this can not be used to change the password.<br> Recommend removing value after the database has been initialized.<br> Container Variable: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD

variables.name: Backup On Start
variables.description: OPTIONS:<br> wiki = Backup mediawiki<br> data = Backup database if you're using the internal MySQL add-on or SQLite<br> assest = Backup file uploads<br> all = Backup wiki, data, and assets<br> false = Do not do a backup during container start<br> Container Variable: BACKUP_MEDIAWIKI
